events.description: Leaves the full-screen mode; the bar's exit button calls it (with a haptic on native).
events.name: onExit

props.description: What is on screen: the register's name, the station, the document.
props.name: title

props.description: Controls drawn before the exit button, such as a lock or a help button.
props.name: actions

props.description: The exit button's accessible name; defaults to the catalogue's "Exit full screen".
props.name: exitLabel

props.description:
Milliseconds without a touch, pointer move or key before the bar slides away; `false` keeps it. Defaults to
4000. The bar never hides while it holds focus or the pointer.
props.name: autoHideMs

props.description:
True on a customer-facing screen (kiosk, KDS, customer display): once hidden, the bar comes back only on a long
press at the top edge, the manager gesture, not on any tap or pointer move. A key press still brings it back on
web, since a keyboard is staff-only there.
props.name: isLocked
